name: Indiamart Intermesh Ltd.
about: IndiaMART InterMESH Limited operates an online business-to-business (B2B) marketplace for business products and services in India and internationally. The company provides an online marketplace that enables listings and discovery of businesses, products, and services; buyer-supplier matchmaking; product search and discovery; request for quotation and BuyLead services; CRM Lead Manager; web storefront solutions; cloud telephony and Premium Number Service (PNS); AI-driven matchmaking; conversational commerce; multimodal search; product specifications and price discovery tools; reviews and ratings services; business enablement software; accounting solutions; and logistics SaaS solutions. reasons: Price implies only ~11% a year growth, below the ~17% that history and analysts support, so expectations look modest.
PE of 18 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 40), though that is a short history to judge by.
